scope: Original-input GPU operator replay: selected frontend/Q/O/gate/residual stages, both complete prompt KV owners, and two complete short causal histories. All inputs and expected endpoints are independently captured from qualified GB10 runs. The complete MTP drafter, MTP MoE, full-prompt Q/O and long-history attention are not qualified by these runs.

compaction.scope: Repeated artifact manifests are retained once per distinct value. Full per-case metadata remains bound by the original run-record and compressed archive hashes; executable arguments and scalar case metadata remain explicit.
